milestones.label: MILESTONES THIS LEVEL
milestones.micro: milestone point -> spend NOW in a FLARED constellation  |  level-up COMET -> spend NOW, anywhere, Flared or not

attributes.label: ATTRIBUTES
attributes.micro: bonus = points in its constellations / 3, rounded down (max +5) - adds to EVERY check, trained or not

defense.label: DEFENSES
defense.ac_micro: Threshold = 10 + level + attribute + proficiency; the check is the same, with a d20
defense.ladder_micro: one ladder: T+4 E+7 M+10 L+13  |  Load Strain = total armor Load - Endure reduction (min 0), off Evade and off Might/Agility skill checks
defenses: level + Presence + prof (+ shield if Raised)
defense.zone_micro: Protection subtracts from every instance of damage landing on that zone, a Graze included. Ordinary Hits go to the torso unless a zone is Exposed.

speed_init.init_micro: initiative is usually an Awareness check: level + Wits + Awareness proficiency

trees.label: TALENT CONSTELLATIONS
trees.micro: pts in constellation: 1 Trained +4 | 4 Expert +7 | 9 Master +10 | 16 Legendary +13; attribute adds on top
trees.foot1: FLR = Flared: crit success OR crit failure on a roll WITH CONSEQUENCES related to a talent in the constellation, opened or not (enemy rolls against you count) - or a GM award, or a week's training. Max 1 new Flare per constellation per session.
trees.foot2: Defenses are Constellations: Awareness, Evade, Guard, Endure, all Trained free at creation, along with Weapons Training. Armor never touches a Defense; it subtracts Protection from damage, and an Exposed Zone's Protection counts as 0. All tiers unlock at L1/5/13/19.

attacks.label: ATTACKS
attacks.micro: atk = level + style's attribute + Weapons proficiency  |  dmg = weapon dice + spec (E+2 M+3 L+4) + Might, minus Protection  |  MAP -5/-10  |  Graze = one weapon die, nothing else

talents.label: TALENTS
talents.micro: name - effect in your own words (full text: page 2 / handbook)

banked.label: HERO POINTS
banked.micro1: 1 at session start, max 3; reroll a check you're Trained or better in;
banked.micro2: spend all (min 1) to refuse death. Talent points are NEVER banked: spend on receipt.

footer: DEGREES: beat the Threshold by 10 = crit success | nat 20/1 steps one degree | a crit either direction on a consequential roll related to a constellation's talents -> that constellation Flares

ANSWERING AN ATTACK: you roll. Beat their Threshold by 10 = Miss. Meet or beat = Graze: some damage, and a Zone of your choice becomes Exposed. Miss = Hit, to the Torso unless a Zone is Exposed. Miss by 10 = Critical Hit, and the attacker picks the Zone. A Posture buys +2 before you know the result, and costs an Exposed Zone win or lose.
HERO POINTS: 1 at session start, max 3 - spend 1 to reroll any check, or spend all of them to refuse death. Refusing death is not a roll and cannot fail.

page2.gear_label: GEAR (no math - stories, traits and properties)
page2.log_micro: what ignited each constellation - the story of your build, one crit at a time
page2.footer: RETRAINING: a month of Downtime moves 1 already spent Talent Point. TRAIN: 7 days with a teacher, rival, or manual Flares that Constellation, once between Milestones.
